name: dw60-longform-remotion
description: Daily World 60 — long-form deep dive renderer (Remotion 16:9). Reads output/<date>/longform.json + generated narration and renders longform-remotion.mp4.

scripts.normalize: ffmpeg -y -i out/_raw.mp4 -af loudnorm=I=-14:TP=-1.5:LRA=11 -c:v copy -c:a aac -b:a 192k out/longform-remotion.mp4 && rm -f out/_raw.mp4
scripts.build: npm run render && npm run normalize
